_comment: Single source of truth for macro indicators (Plan A Tier 1). NOT YET wired into index.html render — see PLAN-macro-json.md for remaining steps. Each value carries a 'source' = the FRED / Trading Economics series ID it will auto-fetch from in Tier 2.

us10y.label: US 10Y Treasury
us10y.note: backed up further after Fed Chair Warsh's hawkish Jackson Hole remarks (27–28 Aug) revived inflation concern; a September hike is now genuinely in play for the 15–16 Sept FOMC

fedFunds.label: Fed Funds Rate
fedFunds.note: the Fed held on 24 Aug citing solid growth + elevated inflation + geopolitical risk; Jackson Hole then revived inflation concern further

usCPI.label: US CPI (YoY)
usCPI.note: August CPI (due before the Sept FOMC) is the key swing input for whether the Fed holds or hikes

usPCE.label: US PCE (YoY)
usPCE.note: not independently re-verified this cycle; watch alongside the CPI print

dxy.label: Dollar Index (DXY)
dxy.note: dipped on a dovish 9-3 Fed-split reading + a Treasury buyback, then rebounded as Jackson Hole's hawkish turn reasserted itself

source.caveat: DXY proper is ICE; DTWEXBGS is FRED's broad trade-weighted USD index — close proxy, label accordingly

biRate.label: Bank Indonesia Rate
biRate.note: IHSG (~6,525) and BBCA (foreign inflows + a fresh dividend) kept extending on fundamentals even as MSCI's Indonesia deletion lands at tomorrow's close (31 Aug)

usdidr.label: USD/IDR
usdidr.note: rupiah holding firmer on the BI hike plus continued foreign equity inflows into Indonesian banks

gold.label: Gold (XAU)
gold.note: pushed higher from ~$4,400 two weeks ago on continued central-bank buying + haven demand — still below January's ~$5,300–5,600 record

source.caveat: no free FRED/TE daily series; keep manual or use a market-data API in a later tier

wti.label: WTI Crude
wti.note: the Hormuz naval-blockade standoff drags on unresolved (Iran wants the blockade lifted first) but hasn't escalated further this fortnight
